name: Ghent University
summary: Flemish research university in Ghent teaching its bachelor's in Dutch; its one English bachelor's is Social Sciences, shared with VUB in Brussels.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is on UGent's direct-admission list. Its Dutch-taught bachelor's need Dutch at B2 on enrolment (C1 for Applied Language Studies); Medicine, Dentistry and Vet need the Flemish entrance exam.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Social Sciences
programmes.ib: Joint with VUB, where you apply. Year 1 mostly at VUB in Brussels; you major in political sciences, communication studies or sociology in year 3.

notes: The study guide lists three English bachelor's, but they are the three majors of this one Social Sciences degree.
For its Dutch-taught bachelor's, UGent's standing deadline is 1 June if you need no visa and 1 April if you do; the page names no year.
